note: The recorded bed takes that exist (doc 25 'Data and interfaces'; read by src/audio/ambience/slot.js). Beds without a listed take play their made-in-code stand-in. When a recording lands, put its files at assets/audio/beds/<layer>/<season>-a.ogg and <season>-b.ogg (and .m4a for older Safari), or a.ogg and b.ogg for an all-season bed, and list the takes here, for example "reeds": {"autumn": ["a", "b"]} or "sea": {"all": ["a", "b"]}. Layers: sea, air, lap, trickle, run, reeds, grass, wind, rain-water, rain-pads, rain-reeds, rain-grass, drizzle. A take written "@<layer>/<name>" is that file, so seasons can share one recording ("@reeds/green-a" is reeds/green-a.ogg). Only listed takes are requested, so the page never asks for a file that is not there; a listed take that fails to load keeps the stand-in and leaves one quiet note in the console.
